name: Harley-Davidson Sportster 883 / 1200
engine: 883 or 1202 cc air-cooled Evolution V-twin, rubber mounted, carb (2004-2006) or fuel injection (2007 on)
intro: The rubber-mount Sportster. Simple and well supported. Know whether yours has a carb or fuel injection.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Many 2019-2021 Sportsters were in recall 21V225 because the headlight bulb can fail and kill both beams.
A-002.reason: Losing the headlight at night is a crash risk. The repair is free.

G: 2004-2006 Sportsters have a carb. 2007 and later are fuel injected. Skip the steps that don't match your bike.

recalls.what: Headlight bulb may fail, losing high and low beam.
recalls.fix: Dealer fits a bulb shield free.
